title: FUL-Wildlife Biologist — U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
summary: You will serve as a FUL-Wildlife Biologist for the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Region 5, Northern Maine National Wildlife Refuge Complex in Baring, Maine. As the Wildlife Biologist, you will plan, develop, coordinate and implement biological programs or a major segment of biological programs, for a refuge or multiple refuges.
